page.overview:
What is Ukkari Hot-Spring Island?

Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is a Paradise island, located somewhere in the proximity of the Arabasta Kingdom. It is where Gedatsu landed and resettled after being defeated in Skypiea.

Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is full of holes created by Goro, so he could build his hot spring resort. It has a forest with three odd-shaped trees and is connected to Arabasta via tunnels.

Dreaming of running a hot spring resort, Goro began digging holes around the island in order to find a hot spring. After Gedatsu landed on the island, he joined Goro in digging. They ended up finding the Dirt Boss, whom Gedatsu beat up and then got to dig the island for them. With the Dirt Boss's help, they finally reached hot water for the resort. They were then approached by the Forest Boss, whom Gedatsu also beat up. While the others left to continue digging a tunnel, the Forest Boss and his workers built the resort's structure.

This island was later linked to Yuba of Arabasta via a tunnel, and now both are connected because of the Hot Spring Resort that they run.
